content.purpose: Build a ranked security report and keep diagnostic noise separate.
content.mentalModel: A production pipeline makes its data path explicit: select, extract, sort, count and rank normal records while redirecting errors to their own evidence file.

remember: A production pipeline makes its data path explicit: select, extract, sort, count and rank normal records while redirecting errors to their own evidence file.
Verify the resulting state before moving on.

tasks.instruction: Create /home/student/answers/failed-users.txt containing “2 admin” and “1 root”, highest count first. Also run a search of /root as student and save its diagnostics separately in /home/student/answers/search-errors.txt.
tasks.suggestedSolution: grep 'Failed password' /home/student/lab/auth.log | awk '{if ($4=="invalid") print $6; else print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | awk '{print $1, $2}' > /home/student/answers/failed-users.txt; LC_ALL=C find /root -name definitely-absent > /dev/null 2> /home/student/answers/search-errors.txt || true
alternateSolutions: awk '/Failed password/{if ($4=="invalid") count[$6]++; else count[$4]++} END{for (user in count) print count[user], user}' /home/student/lab/auth.log | sort -nr > /home/student/answers/failed-users.txt; LC_ALL=C ls /root > /dev/null 2> /home/student/answers/search-errors.txt || true
